content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: regressing (main lifts: 2 up, 0 flat, 3 down).
Sessions: 4 of 6 planned. Sets: 50 (last week 66).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 80 kg x 7 (last week 85 kg x 8), estimated 1RM down 8.4%, 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 70 kg x 7 (last week 75 kg x 8), estimated 1RM down 9.1%, 8 sets this week
- 肩推: 45 kg x 7 (last week 47.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM down 7.8%, 8 sets this week
- 滑輪下拉: 55 kg x 10 (last week 52.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4.8%, 6 sets this week
- 上斜啞鈴臥推: 26 kg x 10 (last week 25 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4%, 6 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 滑輪下拉 55 kg x 10; 上斜啞鈴臥推 26 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle per week (range 10-20 for chest, back, legs, shoulders, glutes): chest 14 (last week 14), shoulders 14 (last week 14), triceps 4 (last week 4), back 14 (last week 14), biceps 4 (last week 4), legs 0 (last week 16).
Body weight: 72.2 kg (-0.3 kg), 1 weigh-in(s) this week.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week: "最近睡不好".
Rules that fired. Advise only on these, by id:
- id "deload:-", priority 100, data {"lifts":"Barbell Bench Press, Barbell Row, Overhead Press","liftsZh":"槓鈴臥推、槓鈴划船、肩推","count":3,"totalSets":50}. Advice: Plan one lighter week: the same exercises at about half of each lift's sets this period (listed above) and clearly lighter weights, then build back up. If the note mentions sleep or stress, suggest looking at it; don't claim it is the cause.
- id "missed_sessions:-", priority 40, data {"done":4,"planned":6,"missed":2,"routines":"腿日, 腿日","dates":"2026-09-30, 2026-10-02","lowGroups":"legs"}. Advice: Name the missed sessions and suggest a realistic way to fit the work in or plan around those days. Never scold; if the note explains it, acknowledge that.
- id "weight_trend:-", priority 30, data {"direction":"gain","periods":5,"latest":"72.2 kg","change":"-0.3 kg"}. Advice: Body weight is moving against the goal: suggest a small daily calorie change (about 200-300 kcal) and steady weigh-ins, not a crash diet.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. items: advice for at most 3 of the fired rules, most important first: usually by priority, but the goal or the note may change the order. A deload, if it fired, is always included and first. Each action is one or two short sentences saying exactly what to do next week, with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise names given above.
